book.title: Shilǝn ki Lya a toh ɗǝ Malkus

content: Yesu te' Ulshelima Ge'shu ki Gunti
Nǝs ɓalnja' nǝ Ulshelima u nǝ Betapaji, nǝ Betanya, a ma' Zǝnga Ki zaitun, i' Yesu shin mil kushtiwasi lob,
I Yesu ulsisu, “Tenge' yakǝn gatlu nǝ kina wakǝn u, Nǝte' twakǝn kǝn en' yakǝn zhaki ki kǝndi, gunǝ bǝmulǝn a to tǝnti gason wai u. A' tǝgǝlǝn ti suɗi.
In mulǝn a ulkinsu, ‘Ya kipǝlin ɗa nǝgu?’ A ulǝnsisu ‘Mulban kǝn ɗǝ lyapti, tǝn patltisut nǝguni.’ ”
Is zǝga, is le'mbi yakǝn zhaki a kina dlabi a bishitu, is tǝngǝlti.
Mɓalǝn inǝ ki dlǝli a lǝbi u, is ulsisu, “Ya laki ki tǝngǝtl yakǝn zhaki u ɗa?”
Is dlǝmisi ulnǝ Yesu pisi u. I mbalǝnni za'si is zǝga,
Nǝs mbǝlli Yesu yakǝn zhaki u, is lala lulutwasǝn tǝnti, it toh tǝnti.
I' hwu' mbalǝn lala lulutwasǝn tǝn shitu i'nami caldwa te' ge' dǝlgǝn i gen' dizhan dwai nǝscali te'ge' dǝlgǝni u.
Mi' ki kina nǝ mi' bǝtl kalwasi asi tlǝl yali asi ussu, “Hosanna! Albalka tǝn mul mbǝ ge' shin ki Lya!
Albalka ki gut mul mbǝti, ki bwasinǝn Dauda! Hosanna ki Lya!”
I Yesu te' Ulshelima, i' te'ge libi ki Lya. Nǝ yaya lutya u nǝ' enlu a gemtu, ippeki illǝ Betǝnya nǝ kult nǝ loppi.
I Yesu Pǝli Pǝ' ki Kah bi
Cilkǝlu nǝ za'ti betanya wasǝn, a Yesu ɗǝ kum kuzǝn.
Nǝ' en pǝkkǝ kah tel lolu u mul dwa lede, Nǝllǝ' ya ni u tambi mil tǝnkiwai. Nǝm mbǝci ma'tu, tambi ulǝn tǝnkiwai amma dwakatl, gaki luɓal kǝpǝtl mil ki kah u wai.
I ul kah nisisu, “Bǝmulǝn ɗam mil lwanǝwai hal patwagi!” Amilkushtiwas ɗǝ kubti.
Yesu Likǝn Libi ki Lya
Is mbǝci Ulshelima, I Yesu tye ge' libi ki Lya i'gop katti mil ultitaka alǝbi, i'dǝzhanisi kundǝn ki ulpwasǝn taka, ne' mil shotti ulpi, ne'mil utl balutaka,
Taza'si sǝllǝ ge' libi ki Lya nǝ ulǝn nǝwai,
Ippisi shilǝn, i ulsisu, “Kilaciɗa: ‘Libi ini nǝndemti libi shilǝn ki Lya ki mi' dǝplǝɓa’ ki ni ɓo ka palliniyi lu dǝpki mǝgǝlsi.”
Nǝbas lǝɓasi nemi' lashti zhil ki Musa nǝskumshilǝni u is gop ngau shitu kigoptiti sǝ'tloti, gaki mbalǝn diɓǝli sikupɓultwasi, mus dopga ki mbalǝn si kup gagashit ki kushtiwasi.
Nǝ su' pǝ u Yesu ne' milkushtiwasi is pe' ɗǝ ge'gadli.
Shilǝn Tǝn Ko'Kǝn Pǝ' ki kah
Nǝkyau si ɓeuti, is ye'kah nǝsi akokkǝnyi hal nǝ tlilgisi,
Bitlus dambǝlti i' ul Yesu su, “Mullashti, nǝya! Kah u nǝ' pǝlibbi u. Akokkǝn i!”
I Yesu ndǝgi. I' ulsisu, “Lakǝn mbadli tǝn Lya”
“Bali a mipi'kini, in mulnǝ a ndǝ nǝ Lya u, tǝn ma' utl calgatl usu, ‘Ndus ɗǝki nda swa ge' dlǝlka u’ abǝ ta bwas mba dlwa swai u nǝn pǝlitti ulisi.
Gaki nǝgu a mi pikkini ulnǝ ka gyemin ge' shilǝn nǝ Lya u, i' ndǝ nǝ nali u, kǝm mbitini.
Kogassi u kǝn kidlǝlni ɗǝ gyep Lya u, in ka ngapǝn mullǝn mbatlu, a tusintaka, Gaki bwaswakǝn ki lya ma tǝn tusi'kin bezǝn lǝɓawakǝn taka.
Inkiɗa tusti mulnǝ ngapǝnti mbatl takawai u bwaswakǝn ki lya ma tikǝn ndusi'kin ulnǝ ki pǝliti u takawai.”
Ngemti tǝn Ndǝtl ki Yesu
Nǝspalswa Ulshelima u, ti dut tyagelu libi ki Lya, i Lǝɓasi ne'mi'bǝl lashti zhil ki Musa, nǝ mi'kina ki mbalǝn is mbǝ ma'ti,
Is ul Yesu su, “Nǝ shitu u kǝn kipǝl usiɗa u? Wokǝn bǝlkishitu kǝpǝlti nǝgu?”
Yesu i' ulsisu, “Ta pǝllikin undi gyepton. A ndǝgi nǝni, amine adlǝmi'kini nǝ ndǝtl ki okǝn amipǝl usi ɗa.
Baptisma ki Yahaya sul lya, kǝnpeka koki mbalǝn kǝni? Dlǝminǝni!”
Is gob shottibi ne' elsǝni asi usu, “In ma ulnǝsu, ‘Sul lya kǝn pe'ku’ tǝn ulminsu ‘Ya lakiɗa bǝma ndǝ ninǝti ɗawai?’
Ngo nǝnǝgu sa ussu, ‘Ki mbalǝn kǝn u’ ” (Siɓulti' hwu'mbalǝn, nǝ kowongi simani Yahaya mul nje shinkǝ ki Lya kǝni.)
Is ndǝgi' Yesu, “Simani wai.” I Yesu usu, “Akǝn pi'kini nǝ ndǝltu kǝn amipǝl usi ɗawai.”
